sections.text:
《Ultrasound elastography》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Physicians have used palpation as a diagnostic examination to understand the elastic properties of pathology for a long time since they realized that tissue stiffness is closely related to its biological characteristics.
